# Bloom

Light bleeding around bright areas. Highlights above a soft threshold are blurred through a chain of half-resolution buffers and added back before tone mapping.

<EffectDemo effect="bloom" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { bloom } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/bloom';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(bloom({ preset: 'subtle' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.intensity = 1`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type      | Default     | Range | Description                                                                              |
| ----------- | --------- | ----------- | ----- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `intensity` | number    | `1`         | 0 – 4 | How much of the blurred light is added back.                                             |
| `threshold` | number    | `1`         | 0 – 8 | Linear brightness above which pixels bloom. 1 is the brightest non-HDR white.            |
| `knee`      | number    | `0.5`       | 0 – 1 | Softness of the threshold, as a fraction of it.                                          |
| `radius`    | number    | `0.7`       | 0 – 1 | Spread: low values keep the glow tight, high values favor the widest blur levels.        |
| `levels`    | integer   | `6`         | 2 – 8 | Number of half-resolution blur levels. More levels reach further and cost a little more. |
| `tint`      | hex color | `'#ffffff'` |       | Color multiplied into the glow.                                                          |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset   | Settings                                                        |
| -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `subtle` | `intensity: 0.5`, `threshold: 1.2`                              |
| `dreamy` | `intensity: 1.4`, `threshold: 0.6`, `knee: 0.8`, `radius: 0.85` |
| `neon`   | `intensity: 2`, `threshold: 0.9`, `knee: 0.2`, `radius: 0.5`    |
| `wide`   | `levels: 8`, `radius: 0.9`, `intensity: 1.2`                    |

Apply one with `bloom({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Blur & glow · tracked as story X5.2 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass. It also renders its own intermediate passes before the merged pass.
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 5.3 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/bloom`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Jimenez, Next Generation Post Processing in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, SIGGRAPH 2014 (13-tap downsample, tent upsample, Karis average); Unity soft-knee threshold curve, as described in its documentation.
